action.objective: Verify Bb4 as the sole candidate with the reserved 2000-node allowance at full depth 4, then commit the verified move.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search suggested Bb4 at 942 (exact), the strongest exact evidence so far, and reserved_verification protects it. It keeps the bishop active on the a3-f8 diagonal while supporting g4, and Black's only real counter is Rxa3/Rxg4. Single-candidate verification at depth 4 checks for any Black mate-in-one and forcing refutation before I commit.
